metadata.purpose: Compact scientific regression evidence for the classical SincroLab V0.1 SMIB model.
metadata.tolerance_policy: Exact comparisons protect categorical and event-count contracts. Unit-bearing absolute tolerances and upper bounds protect selected scalar scientific observations without representing physical uncertainty. For classic_undamped, cct_search.time_tolerance_s is only H19's maximum final bracket width, while each expected endpoint abs_tolerance_s is an independent deterministic-regression tolerance; neither is integration error or CCT uncertainty.
limitations: Expected values apply only to the stated synthetic inputs, model assumptions, numerical configuration, and tolerances.
Temporal CCT brackets are resolution-dependent estimates, not exact or universal critical clearing times.
First-swing observations classify sampled trajectories and do not establish global or asymptotic stability.

classic_undamped.purpose: Preserve analytic equal-area angles and their independent temporal cross-check under zero damping.

cct_search.tolerance_interpretation: time_tolerance_s limits only the bisection bracket width; it is not an integration-error estimate.

delta_initial_rad.provenance: Closed-form asin(Pm_pu/Pmax_prefault_pu) validated in H02 and H16.

delta_critical_rad.provenance: Closed-form equal-area critical angle independently derived and validated in H17.

stable_t_clear_s.provenance: Accepted deterministic H19 numerical regression at dt_s=0.005 s; H20 cross-checked its clearing angle against the independent analytic H17 critical angle, but the temporal value is not an independent oracle.

unstable_t_clear_s.provenance: Accepted deterministic H19 numerical regression at dt_s=0.005 s; H20 cross-checked its clearing angle against the independent analytic H17 critical angle, but the temporal value is not an independent oracle.

stable_clearing_angle_rad.provenance: Accepted numerical angle from the stable H19 endpoint trajectory; H20 cross-checked it against the independent analytic H17 critical angle, but this value is not an independent oracle.

unstable_clearing_angle_rad.provenance: Accepted numerical angle from the unstable H19 endpoint trajectory; H20 cross-checked it against the independent analytic H17 critical angle, but this value is not an independent oracle.

critical_angle_within_temporal_angle_bra.provenance: Independent analytic/temporal consistency established in H20.

classic_undamped.limitations: Equal Area requires D_pu=0 and the documented classical forward first-swing assumptions. The temporal bracket remains tied to dt_s; time_tolerance_s controls H19 stopping, while endpoint abs_tolerance_s controls only golden regression comparison. Neither tolerance is physical uncertainty or actual CCT error.

scipy_cross_checked_transient.purpose: Preserve externally cross-checked error bounds without making SciPy a runtime dependency.

max_abs_delta_error_rad.provenance: External numerical solve_ivp oracle validated in H21 using the same SincroLab SMIB RHS; it cross-checks RK4 integration and segmented event handling, not the physical equations independently.

max_abs_omega_dev_error_pu.provenance: External numerical solve_ivp oracle validated in H21 using the same SincroLab SMIB RHS; it cross-checks RK4 integration and segmented event handling, not the physical equations independently.

scipy_cross_checked_transient.limitations: These are regression bounds for one numerical configuration, not physical uncertainty or universal solver accuracy. SciPy and RK4 share SincroLab's SMIB RHS, so this evidence is numerically external but does not independently validate the model equations.

metadata.purpose: Stable first-swing regression and educational reference for SincroLab.
Unstable first-swing regression and educational reference within the controlled SincroLab family.
Adversarial regression near the sampled first-swing boundary for SincroLab.
metadata.adversarial_characteristic: The sampled assessment is STABLE at the tested dt_s values up to 0.1 and UNSTABLE at dt_s = 0.2 for the same model inputs.
metadata.limitation: This case exposes time-step sensitivity; it is not a CCT result or a claim that either coarse trajectory is numerically converged.
